title: Morning Window
lyrics:
Sunlight draws a line across the floor
A quiet day is waiting at the door

title: Paper Kites
lyrics:
We sent our wishes up above the trees
And watched them wander with the evening breeze

title: Harbor Lights
lyrics:
The harbor keeps a lantern for the night
A steady promise shining warm and bright

title: Small Constellations
lyrics:
A thousand little sparks begin to show
The dark is just a place for stars to glow

title: Open Road
lyrics:
The map is folded but the miles are wide
We find the way by taking every stride

title: Rain on Cedar
lyrics:
The cedar sings beneath the silver rain
And every rooftop answers back again

title: Blue Bicycle
lyrics:
A blue bicycle rolls past the park
With a bell that chases shadows from the dark

title: Kitchen Radio
lyrics:
A little song is spinning by the stove
The room gets brighter as the chorus flows

title: Winter Garden
lyrics:
Beneath the frost a seed remembers spring
The patient earth is practicing to sing

title: Last Train Home
lyrics:
The last train hums beneath the town's glow
It carries every tired dream back home
